name: a store of facts that is applied automatically to every new problem keeps growing, and the facts start to fight
condition: The organism holds a store of transformations it has accepted as true. On every problem, EVERY stored transformation that applies is applied, without the organism choosing which, until nothing applies. The store grows over the organism's life (new facts arrive from the world or from the organism's own successes) and is never curated by the world. Fitness is earned by reaching a stable answer on each problem within a fixed budget of transformation steps; a run that exhausts the budget scores zero on that problem; a run that reaches an answer that a later problem contradicts is penalised.
capability_rewarded: Keeping the store in a state where automatic exhaustive application terminates and reaches the same answer regardless of the order in which applicable transformations are attempted; detecting, before or during application, that two stored facts undo each other or that one fact reorders without progress; refusing or ordering such facts so that progress is monotone.
world_requirements: a term language with at least one binary operator for which both orders of arguments are equal in the world's ground truth (so a reordering fact IS true and IS a trap)
a stream of problems whose answers are checkable by the world independently of the organism's transformations (ground truth by evaluation, not by agreement)

a fact stream that over the run includes: facts whose two sides are the same up to variable permutation; pairs of facts that invert each other; facts that are true but whose application does not shrink anything
a per-problem step budget that is large enough for the honest solution path and small enough that a loop hits it; the budget is a world parameter, not chosen by the organism
a log of steps per problem so that 'terminated because nothing applies' and 'terminated because the budget ran out' are distinguishable by the world
vacuity_condition: Vacuous if the fact stream never contains a permutative or mutually inverse pair (then every store terminates trivially), OR if the step budget is so large that loops never bite, OR if the problems can be answered without applying any stored fact (then the store is decoration). Eligibility count required before the world is run: the number of planted looping pairs in the stream must be > 0 and reported.
trivial_shortcuts: ignore the store entirely and answer by direct evaluation (closable: some problems must be unanswerable without a stored fact -- a fact the world reveals only through the stream)
apply each fact at most once per problem (closable: some problems need the same fact several times)
reject every new fact (closable: fitness requires facts learned mid-run to be used)
cap steps privately and report 'stable' at the cap (closable: the world owns the step counter and distinguishes stable from exhausted)
cheat_control: Plant a known permutative pair (a commutativity fact) and a known mutually-inverse pair in the stream at a known time. The world can reward the capability iff an organism that carries a working ordering-or-refusal discipline survives the planting with its step counts unchanged, while a copy of the same organism with that discipline disabled hits the budget on the first problem after the planting. If the two copies score the same, the world does not reward the capability and the pressure is not operational.
negative_control: The same stream with the planted pairs removed: the disciplined and undisciplined copies must score the same (the capability must earn nothing when nothing fights).
notes: Stated without the mechanism. The organism may solve it by ordering, by refusing facts, by detecting oscillation at run time, or by something Nyx has not thought of; the world rewards the outcome. The famous ancestor solves it with a fixed term order applied to facts detected as permutations at ingestion plus a hard step cap; that is ONE solution and it leaks nothing here because it is not named.
